action_label: Connect Floriday and schedule its jobs
description:
Client ID, secret, scope, API key, token URL and base URL, plus the organisation and warehouse ids.

Each job — sales orders, batches, supply lines, order fulfilment, stock, token refresh — has its own toggle and frequency and becomes its own Scheduled Job Type row. Those rows are re-created by the app's `after_migrate`, so a migrate never leaves the connector unscheduled.
